passkeys.intro: A passkey replaces the password: fingerprint, face or device PIN. It never leaves your device, and only works on this server.

style.title: Style of this device
style.intro: Layout, headings, poster shapes and section colors. Background, text and accent colors come from your profile's theme.
style.warning: A theme is a CSS file: it can change the whole display, but neither run code nor load anything. Only import themes from trusted sources.

universe.name: Univers
universe.description: Light, a bold color per section, pale tints on large surfaces.

lantern.name: Magic lantern
lantern.description: Dark and warm, a single amber accent, serif headings.

profileTheme.title: Your profile's theme
profileTheme.intro: Colors, corner radius, density and font, on all your devices. Themes are created by a server administrator, and they are all readable.

themeFile.notATheme: This file isn't a Laterna theme: it must start with a "/* @laterna-theme ... */" comment.
themeFile.noName: The theme manifest has no name ("name: ..." line).
themeFile.badName: The theme name must contain at least one letter or digit.
themeFile.noImport: "@import" is not allowed: a theme fits in a single file.
themeFile.remote: A theme loads nothing from elsewhere: fonts and images are embedded as "data:" ({{urls}}).
themeFile.remoteParsed: A theme loads nothing from elsewhere: fonts and images are embedded as "data:".
themeFile.empty: This file contains no CSS rules.
themeFile.reserved: "{{id}}" is the name of a theme shipped with the app: change "name" or "id".
themeFile.noSpace: Not enough space left on this device to keep this theme.

adminThemes.title: Themes
adminThemes.subtitle: Colors, corner radius, density and font, for web, mobile and TV. Each profile picks its own.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Applied right away, without restarting the server.
settings.foldersHint: Set when the server starts (options and environment variables).
settings.name: Name announced to devices
settings.graceHint: A file that comes back before then keeps its history.
settings.watchHint: A change starts a scan after 10 s of quiet; the automatic scan remains the safety net.
settings.imagesHint: Posters, thumbnails, cast photos. Off: no requests to the Internet.
settings.trickplayHint: Generated in the background, one file at a time.
settings.segments: Detect intros and credits by sound
settings.segmentsHint: Compares the audio of episodes in the same season, in the background. Named chapters are always used.
settings.purgeHint: Expired sessions, activity older than 90 days, files no longer used · usually every day.
settings.transcodesHint: 0 = automatic: 4 with a hardware encoder, otherwise one per four cores. Beyond that, a new playback is refused; one in progress is never cut.
settings.languageHint: Language of the texts the server writes when neither the device nor the profile asks for one it knows.

adminOverview.title: Overview
adminOverview.ffmpegMissing: not found: no analysis and no transcoding
adminOverview.notLinkedText: Not linked: NFOs are reread at the periodic scan.

adminLibraries.title: Libraries
adminLibraries.subtitle: Laterna reads your folders and never modifies a file.
adminLibraries.analysisContinues: analysis of the new files continues
adminLibraries.none: No library: create one to get started.
adminLibraries.oneKindText: Movies, TV shows (and anime), music, books or photos: the kind decides how files are understood. Metadata come from NFOs and images placed next to the media.
adminLibraries.pick: Choose "Edit" on a library, or create one.
adminLibraries.orderHint: The order of the libraries, set with the arrows on their cards, is the order of their lists and of the recently added rows on the home page.

libraryEditor.name: Name
libraryEditor.folders: Folders, as the server sees them
libraryEditor.browse: Browse the server's folders for folder {{n}}
libraryEditor.note: Laterna never modifies a file. A folder that becomes unreachable doesn't empty the library; a missing file is forgotten after the configured delay.
libraryEditor.savedScan: Library saved; a scan has started.
libraryEditor.deleteText: Its catalog disappears from Laterna, along with the history and favorites related to it. The files stay on disk.

adminAccounts.title: Accounts
adminAccounts.subtitle: One account per person or household, each with its profiles.
adminAccounts.aboutText: An account's libraries and parental control apply to all its profiles; each profile can be stricter. An administrator sees everything and manages the server.
adminAccounts.pick: Choose an account to edit it, or create one.

accountEditor.sameNameProfile: A profile with the same name is created with it.
accountEditor.ownPasswordBefore: Your own password is changed in
accountEditor.passwordHint: Signs out every device of the account.
accountEditor.noLibrary: No library: this account will see nothing.
accountEditor.parentalHint: Adds to each profile's own: the stricter wins.
accountEditor.adminHint: Sees everything, without parental control, and manages the server.
accountEditor.disabledHint: No sign-in possible; signs out all its devices.
accountEditor.deleteText: Its profiles go with it, and their data: history, favorites, playlists.

adminDevices.title: Devices

adminDevices.subtitle_other: {{count}} devices connected, most recent first. A signed-out device has to sign in again with a password.

adminActivity.title: Activity
adminActivity.subtitle: Sign-ins, playbacks, changes and alerts; the server keeps 90 days.

adminTasks.title: Tasks
adminTasks.subtitle: Analysis, images, subtitles, thumbnails, downloads: the server does them in the background.
adminTasks.idle: Nothing waiting: the server is resting.

adminLogs.title: Logs
adminLogs.subtitle: The last 2,000 messages in memory; daily files, 14 days.
adminLogs.searchPlaceholder: Search a message, a file, a request_id...

adminArr.subtitle: They write NFOs and images, and notify Laterna of every import.

adminArr.refreshing: {{name}} is refreshing its {{what}}; the libraries will be rescanned.

adminAuth.title: Authentication
adminAuth.subtitle: How accounts sign in to this server.
adminAuth.passwordText: Always available, as a fallback for the other methods.
adminAuth.passkeysText: Fingerprint, face or security key. Each account adds its own in "My account".
adminAuth.oidcText: Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak... A single sign-in for your services.
adminAuth.tvText: The TV shows an eight-letter code and a QR code to {{address}}, where it is approved from a signed-in device. A code is valid for 10 minutes; a kid profile or a profile under parental control can't approve one.
adminAuth.tvNoAddress: The TV shows an eight-letter code, approved in Laterna from a signed-in device (Pair a device). Set the public address so the TV also shows the page and a QR code. A code is valid for 10 minutes; a kid profile or a profile under parental control can't approve one.
adminAuth.addressText: The address at which devices reach the server. It sets the passkey identifier and the OpenID Connect callback address: changing it makes existing passkeys unusable.
adminAuth.webUrlHint: Where Laterna opens in a browser, if not at the public address. TVs send people there to approve their code; empty: the public address.
adminAuth.rpIdHint: A parent domain of the public address, for a client hosted on another subdomain; empty: the address's host.
adminAuth.origins: Other allowed origins (one per line, ten at most)
adminAuth.trust: The provider is trusted for usernames: an account with the same name is linked to it on first sign-in. Only set one where people can't pick their own name (Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak).
adminAuth.keepSecret: Empty: the current secret is kept.
adminAuth.autoCreate: Create the account on first sign-in
adminAuth.autoCreateHint: Regular account, all libraries, profile with the same name. Otherwise, only existing accounts get in.
adminAuth.callback: Callback address, to declare with the provider
adminAuth.needAddressFirst: Set the server's public address first.

adminObs.title: Observability
adminObs.subtitle: Monitor the server from Prometheus, Grafana or any OpenTelemetry tool.
adminObs.opened: Metrics opened: the token below is shown only once.
adminObs.metricsText: Requests per route and per procedure, playbacks and FFmpeg runs in progress, task queue, catalog, process memory, database size.
adminObs.tokenFor: Read token, to give to Prometheus:
adminObs.oldInvalid: The old one will stop working.
adminObs.tracesText: Every request, background task, FFmpeg run and outgoing call becomes a span, sent over OTLP/HTTP (JSON) to the configured collector: Jaeger, Tempo, Grafana Alloy, OpenTelemetry collector.
adminObs.tracesConfig: Set when the server starts through the standard variables, not from here. Without a collector, nothing is traced and nothing costs.
adminObs.traceId: The access log gives each request's trace_id: you find the trace from the logs.

setup.subtitle: first-time setup
setup.welcomeLead: Create the administrator account for this server. You can add other accounts and profiles afterwards.
setup.librariesLead: Tell Laterna where your media is. It scans it and keeps it up to date, without ever modifying a file.
setup.goodToKnowText: Metadata comes from the NFO files and images next to your media. Sonarr and Radarr write them for you: we link them in the next step.
setup.integrationsLead: Optional. Once linked, Laterna asks them to write the NFOs and images, and learns right away when an episode or a movie arrives.
setup.readyLead: Laterna is scanning your libraries. Movies, series, albums, books and photos appear as the scan goes.

adminBackups.title: Backups
adminBackups.subtitle: Copies of the database, taken without stopping the server.
adminBackups.restoreStaged: Restore staged: it will be applied at the next start of the server.
adminBackups.pendingText: It will replace the database at the next start of the server.
adminBackups.howRestore: A restore replaces the database at the next start of the server: everything changed since the backup is lost, and the current database is kept among the backups. A backup from a newer version of Laterna, or an unreadable one, is refused.
adminBackups.howCli: Without the web client: the commands "laterna backup" and "laterna restore", server stopped.
adminBackups.restoreText: It will replace the database at the next start of the server. Everything that changed since then will be lost; the current database will be kept among the backups.
adminBackups.deleteText: The file disappears from the server.
adminBackups.keepHint: Taken every night, the oldest dropped beyond this number; 0 = no automatic backup. Manual backups are kept until deleted.
